topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Progression
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning objectives, lecture framing, and the hallmarks of cancer conceptual framework.

topics.label: Growth Signaling Independence and Evasion of Growth Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how mutations in signaling cascades such as Wnt, RTKs, and TGF-beta drive autonomous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Blocks in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how malignant transformation arrests terminal differentiation across both hematopoietic lineages and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the mitochondrial apoptotic pathway and the regulatory balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins like p53, Bax, and BCL2.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere dynamics induce senescence and how cancer cells reactivate telomerase to achieve immortalization.

topics.label: Reprogramming of Cellular Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze how cancer cells rewire metabolic pathways such as aerobic glycolysis and the Krebs cycle to support biosynthetic demands.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how growing tumors overcome nutrient and oxygen diffusion limits by activating the angiogenic switch to form new vasculature.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Clonal Genetics of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the steps of the metastatic cascade, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, and the clonal genomic features underlying dissemination.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer delivers concluding remarks on cancer hallmark literature, summarises key goals, and closes the session.
